title: Gradient Hölder regularity for singular fractional $p$-Laplace equations
summary: Let $n\ge2$, $1 p-1$. We prove that every globally bounded fractional $p$-harmonic function is locally $C^{1,α}$ for some $α=α(n,p,s)>0$. This settles the open problem of interior gradient Hölder regularity in the singular range throughout the natural first-order regime $sp>p-1$. The proof combines an affine-invariant improvement-of-flatness argument with a Liouville theorem for globally Lipschitz entire solutions.
